_comment: BUG-002 request R8: two_channel_bidir_one_idle_600 with a 4500 ms arming window instead of 2000 ms, nothing else changed. The R3 runs showed each failing ESC resetting 1.85-2.3 s after arm() and coming back up ~0.7 s later, under throttle 100 with a 2000 ms window; AM32 then needs >1 s of zeros before it arms (about 3.6 s after arm()), which a 3000 ms window also misses (the earlier A/B retest) but 4500 ms covers. Passing 3/3 confirms that timing chain; motor 0 failing with a second reset in arming.bin means the reset repeats.
